title: Crop Yield Anomaly Explorer from Weather and Satellite Indices
description: Joins district yield records with rainfall and vegetation index time series, flags seasons that deviate from what weather alone predicts and discusses what else could explain each deviation.

title: Library Loan Patterns and Collection Planning Analysis
description: Analyses anonymised borrowing records to show which genres peak in exam weeks, which titles are never borrowed and what weeding or purchasing choices the numbers could support.

title: Music Listening Habits Report from Exported Streaming History
description: Reads a personal listening history export, charts how taste changes across months and times of day and lets the user explore the data locally without uploading it anywhere.

title: Match Event Data Analysis for Football Passing Networks
description: Builds passing networks from open event data, measures which players link the team together and compares network measures with simple match outcomes while noting how small the samples are.
